north_star: Discover Your Unique Life Patterns through source-faithful episode decomposition and participant adjudication of person-level recurrence, scope, conditions and exceptions.
core_invariants: Neutrality does not require a closed behavioral taxonomy.
Every later competing model must consume the same immutable pre-model semantic bundle.
Later model adapters must not reread raw participant narrative to create model-specific semantics.
Episode facts are source-supported propositions, not person-level traits.
Narrator-reported appraisal must remain distinct from an objectively established condition.
A genuine absence assertion is established only when awareness, opportunity, reasonable feasibility and established nonoccurrence are all established for the defined window.
Failure of an absence gate never deletes independently supported positive facts.
Clear behavior remains representable even when no category, facet or index term fits.
Episode counts and external classifier agreement may support question generation or QA but cannot finalize participant-level recurrence, typicality or scope.
Only participant adjudication may finalize a person-level pattern as accepted, rejected or unresolved.
Elicited examples are boundary and meaning evidence by default, not an unbiased recurrence-frequency sample.
System proposals, participant corrections and subsequent revisions remain separately inspectable and are never overwritten in place.
Rejected and unresolved hypotheses remain first-class frozen records rather than being collapsed into missingness.

episode_fact_record.purpose: Preserve the smallest source-supported positive proposition needed for faithful source representation, follow-up questioning and later participant adjudication without requiring a personality taxonomy.

field_semantics.fact_id: Stable identifier for this atomic proposition. A substantive proposition change requires a successor record rather than silent mutation.
field_semantics.episode_id: Identifier of the frozen source episode to which the proposition belongs.
field_semantics.fact_kind: Coarse process/indexing role. It organizes questioning and retrieval and is not a personality construct.
field_semantics.epistemic_role: Controls what kind of claim the proposition is allowed to make. reported_appraisal cannot be promoted to externally_supported_condition without independent source support.
field_semantics.proposition: Neutral source-faithful proposition in ordinary language. Open-world text is authoritative over optional tags.
field_semantics.source_provenance_ids: One or more exact frozen source references supporting the proposition.
field_semantics.sequence_refs: Optional ordered references to other fact IDs when source-supported temporal ordering matters.
field_semantics.context_qualifiers: Optional source-supported context or life-phase qualifiers.
field_semantics.index_tags: Optional extensible retrieval/question-generation tags. No tag is required for a fact to remain valid and tags never replace proposition text.
field_semantics.uncertainty_note: Optional explicit uncertainty or ambiguity that does not justify discarding the supported portion of the proposition.

rules: A clear positive proposition with exact provenance is valid even if index_tags is empty.
No category or facet mismatch may convert a clear positive proposition into insufficient evidence.
Do not encode nonoccurrence as an episode_fact_record; use absence_assessment_record.
Do not combine a narrator appraisal and an objective condition into one proposition unless the source independently establishes both and they are separately representable.
A proposition may be narrower than the source sentence when decomposition is needed, but it may not add causal, dispositional, frequency or trait meaning absent from the source.

absence_assessment_record.purpose: Represent a proposed genuine absence/nonoccurrence claim without allowing silence, missing detail or a failed counterfactual gate to masquerade as observed absence.
absence_assessment_record.establishment_rule: assertion_status may equal established_absence if and only if awareness == established AND opportunity == established AND reasonable_feasibility == established AND established_nonoccurrence == established.
rules: Unmentioned action is not established nonoccurrence.
Unclear or not-established gate elements may be retained for audit and follow-up question generation.
An unestablished or unclear absence assessment cannot delete, weaken or reclassify independently supported positive episode facts.
Narrator belief that an action was impossible belongs in a reported_appraisal fact unless reasonable feasibility is independently established as an objective condition.

pattern_candidate_record.purpose: Preserve a proposed person-level generalization as a hypothesis/question before participant adjudication.

field_semantics.proposal_text: System's current neutral formulation of the possible recurring pattern; not yet participant truth.
field_semantics.question_text: Non-leading question actually presented or proposed for presentation to the participant.
field_semantics.supporting_fact_ids: Facts that motivated the candidate. Multiplicity may justify asking a question but cannot finalize recurrence.
field_semantics.proposed_scope: Optional hypothesis about contexts/life phases; must remain visibly provisional.
field_semantics.proposed_conditions: Optional hypothesis about conditions/triggers; must remain visibly provisional.
field_semantics.parent_candidate_id: Optional predecessor when a candidate is revised after participant feedback.

rules: A candidate may be generated from one episode if the purpose is to ask a useful neutral question; it is still not a person-level pattern until adjudicated.
Multiple similar episodes do not automatically promote a candidate to accepted recurrence.
Question wording must permit rejection, contextualization, exception and uncertainty rather than presupposing that the pattern exists.
The system proposal remains separately inspectable after participant correction.

pattern_adjudication_round_record.purpose: Capture the participant's response to a particular candidate formulation and preserve corrections without overwriting the proposal.

field_semantics.participant_formulation: Participant wording or faithfully normalized participant-confirmed wording when the proposal is revised or accepted.
field_semantics.recurrence_statement: Participant-confirmed statement about whether/how this recurs. Free text is allowed so the schema does not force artificial frequency bins.
field_semantics.scope_statement: Participant-confirmed contexts, domains or life phases in which the formulation applies.
field_semantics.exception_statements: Participant-confirmed exceptions or contexts where the proposed pattern does not apply.
field_semantics.adjudication_source_provenance_ids: Exact source references for the participant judgment/correction.
field_semantics.example_links: Examples/counterexamples/nuance records linked with explicit evidence roles.
field_semantics.example_retrieval_status: Optional state recording whether examples were retrieved, not retrieved, withheld/private, or not requested.
field_semantics.retrieval_discrepancy_note: Optional neutral note when endorsement and example retrieval diverge; does not imply poor self-awareness.

rules: Elicited examples and counterexamples primarily refine meaning, scope and boundary conditions.
An elicited example is not an unbiased recurrence-frequency observation merely because the participant can produce it.
A participant may accept a pattern while failing to retrieve examples. Preserve both facts and probe neutrally if appropriate.
Do not infer poor self-awareness from endorsement-without-example retrieval.
A repeated endorsement/retrieval discrepancy may become a candidate meta-pattern only through the same participant-adjudication process.
Rejected and unresolved judgments are retained and can motivate revised questions; they are not missing data.

final_pattern_record.purpose: Represent the participant-adjudicated current disposition of a person-level pattern while preserving the full proposal/adjudication history.

field_semantics.canonical_formulation: Participant-confirmed formulation for accepted patterns; may also preserve the exact rejected/unresolved formulation for audit.
field_semantics.supporting_fact_ids: Episode facts linked as source support or context. Their count is descriptive only.
field_semantics.candidate_history_ids: Ordered candidate/adjudication history sufficient to reconstruct revisions without overwriting earlier states.

rules: Only a participant adjudication record may determine final_state.
No count threshold, external coder consensus or automated classifier result may directly determine final_state.
Accepted patterns require a participant-confirmed formulation or an explicit accepted-as-worded adjudication.
Rejected patterns remain adapter-visible as rejected hypotheses/constraints.
Unresolved patterns remain adapter-visible with their uncertainty rather than being coerced to accepted/rejected.
Finalization does not claim objective causal truth; it records participant-adjudicated self-characterization and scope.

optional_index_vocabulary.purpose: Retrieval, question generation, coverage diagnostics and theory-blind vocabulary-gap discovery.
rules: No index category is required for semantic preservation.
A fact with no suitable term remains valid with an empty tag set.
Repeated unmatched clear facts may create a vocabulary_gap_candidate.
Vocabulary-gap handling must never rewrite or discard the underlying fact.
If a future bounded vocabulary is made normative for a narrow decision, it requires its own open-world escape and fresh theory-blind review.
optional_index_vocabulary.historical_os_disposition: The historical universal OS safeguard is superseded as a mandatory core code because open-world fact propositions themselves provide the escape. Its preservation principle remains mandatory.

adapter_input_bundle.purpose: Give every later competing model the same immutable neutral semantic input while preventing model-specific rereading of raw narrative.
adapter_input_bundle.raw_source_policy: Raw transcript/episode narrative is audit provenance, not an adapter input surface. Model adapters must consume the frozen semantic projection rather than rereading raw narrative for model-specific interpretation.
adapter_rules: All competing model adapters bind the same bundle_sha256.
Adapters may not mutate episode facts, epistemic roles, participant judgments, scope, conditions or exceptions.
Adapters may not promote reported appraisal to objective condition.
Adapters may not derive a replacement recurrence judgment from episode counts.
Adapters may not hide rejected or unresolved participant pattern records by treating them as absent.
If a model requires information absent from the bundle, record model-input missingness rather than performing a model-specific source reread.
Model-specific mapping may occur only downstream of this frozen neutral bundle under its own versioned/frozen protocol.

calibration_contract.forbidden_success_definition: External-coder agreement on a supposedly true person-level label that the participant has not adjudicated.

implementation_gate.unblock_condition: Independent fresh target-theory-blind review must approve this exact candidate architecture and contract, with review identity bound to their exact committed contents.
